purpose: Data for browser mini-experiments: contact threshold, residue partners and virtual alanine truncation on the crystal-symmetry TNF trimer.

flag_bits.rules: Same atom-type and distance rules as data/processed/full-epitope.json; H-bond ≤ 3.5 Å, salt bridge ≤ 4.0 Å, side-chain C–C ≤ 4.0 Å.

limitations: Contacts between the TNF trimer and the Fab bound to protomer A only.
Virtual alanine removes atoms beyond Cβ in a rigid structure; it predicts neither ΔΔG, affinity nor clinical effect.
Distance candidates are not measured hydrogen bonds or energies.
